segments.an4.206:1.2: sappurisañca, sappurisena sappurisatarañca. Taṃ suṇātha … pe ….
segments.an4.206:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti … pe … micchāñāṇī hoti, micchāvimutti hoti.
segments.an4.206:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā ca micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, parañca micchādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti … pe … attanā ca micchāñāṇī hoti, parañca micchāñāṇe samādapeti;
segments.an4.206:3.3: attanā ca micchāvimutti hoti, parañca micchāvimuttiyā samādapeti.
segments.an4.206:4.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti … pe … sammāñāṇī hoti, sammāvimutti hoti.
segments.an4.206:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā ca sammādiṭṭhiko hoti, parañca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti … pe … attanā ca sammāñāṇī hoti, parañca sammāñāṇe samādapeti;
segments.an4.206:5.3: attanā ca sammāvimutti hoti, parañca sammāvimuttiyā samādapeti.

lines: Pāṇātipāte samādapetīti yathā pāṇaṃ atipāteti, tathā naṃ tattha gahaṇaṃ gaṇhāpeti.
Ayaṃ vuccatīti ayaṃ evarūpo puggalo yasmā sayaṃkatena ca dussīlyena samannāgato, yañca samādapitena kataṃ, tato upaḍḍhassa dāyādo, tasmā “asappurisena asappurisataro”ti vuccati.
Sappurisena sappurisataroti attanā ca katena susīlyena samannāgatattā yañca samādapito karoti, tato upaḍḍhassa dāyādattā uttamapurisena uttamapurisataro.
Ettha ca parena kataṃ dussīlyaṃ susīlyaṃ vā āṇattiyā attanā ca vacippayogena katanti āṇāpanavasena pasutapāpassa puññassa vā dāyādo “tato upaḍḍhassa dāyādo”ti vutto.
